description: This is a screenshot of the "General Information" section within the CLC+ Core user interface, displaying metadata for a dataset named "ES616_10m". The form details include: Name "ES616_10m"; Country "ES Spain/España"; Region "ES616 Jaén". The "Reference Year" field is currently empty. The "Time Range of Ingested Data" is specified as "01.01.2017 – 31.12.2018". The "INSPIRE Themes" field is empty, but includes a link to the "INSPIRE theme register" (referencing Directive 2007/2/EC, the Infrastructure for Spatial Information in the European Community Directive). The data Resolution is "10 m". The dataset was "Created By" "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support". Associated Organisations are "CLC" (Corine Land Cover) and "European Environment Agency (EEA)". The "Contact Person" is "copernicus@eea.europa.eu". The "Description Abstract" states: "CLC2018 is one of the Corine Land Cover (CLC) datasets produced within the frame the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)". The "Initial Spatial Resolution" is "0 m", and the "Initial Coordinate Reference System (CRS)" is "EPSG:4326". The "Initial Type of Data" is "Vector", and the "Attribute Name" is "Code_18". The "Excluded Class Code" field is empty. "CANCEL" and "SAVE" action buttons are visible in the top right corner.
